# Curry and Grill

> Curry and Grill in Vandalia, OH offers flavorful Indian and Himalayan cuisine, featuring traditional curries, biryanis, and grilled specialties. Diners frequently enjoy favorites such as chicken tikka masala, garlic naan, and momos.

## Menu
Curry and Grill in Vandalia, OH is known for its flavorful Indian and Himalayan cuisine, offering a variety of traditional curries, biryanis, and grilled specialties. Diners frequently enjoy favorites like chicken tikka masala, garlic naan, and momos.

- Lunch Buffet
